lose-fat.label: Lose fat
lose-fat.hint: Higher reps, shorter rests and cardio finishers.

build-muscle.label: Build muscle
build-muscle.hint: Moderate reps and steady progressive load.

stay-fit.label: Stay fit & healthy
stay-fit.hint: Balanced training that fits your life.

endurance.label: Build endurance
endurance.hint: Higher reps, short rests and conditioning.

beginner.label: Beginner
beginner.hint: New to training or coming back after a long break.

intermediate.label: Intermediate
intermediate.hint: Training regularly for a year or more.

advanced.label: Advanced
advanced.hint: Several years of consistent, structured training.

gym.label: At the gym
gym.hint: Full access to machines and free weights.

hybrid.label: Both
hybrid.hint: Home gear plus a gym on some days.

knees.label: Knees
knees.hint: Avoid deep or high-impact knee loading.

lower-back.label: Lower back
lower-back.hint: Avoid heavy hinging and spinal loading.

shoulders.label: Shoulders
shoulders.hint: Avoid heavy overhead and wide pressing.

heart-bp.label: Heart or blood pressure
heart-bp.hint: Avoid max-effort and heavy straining work.

apple.label: Apple Watch / Health
apple.hint: Heart rate and recovery from Apple Health.

garmin.label: Garmin
garmin.hint: Heart rate and activity from Garmin Connect.

onboarding.name: What should we call you?
onboarding.equipmentNote: Leave everything unchecked for bodyweight-only training.
onboarding.daysNote: We spread sessions out so there is always recovery between them.
onboarding.heartNote: We'll avoid max-effort and heavy straining exercises. Please check with your doctor before starting a new training program.
onboarding.wearableNote: Connections run in Demo Mode in the browser. You can manage them anytime under Devices.
onboarding.noPreview: Adjust your answers to see a preview.
onboarding.demoHistoryNote: Fills Progress with sample past workouts so you can explore everything. Remove it anytime in Settings.
onboarding.editNote: Upcoming planned workouts will be rebuilt. Past sessions are kept.
